title: dactylorhiza × conigera nothosubsp. evae
intro: Dactylorhiza × conigera nothosubsp. evae, commonly known as a hybrid orchid, is a rare and unusual plant species derived from the cross between Dactylorhiza conigera and possibly Dactylorhiza incarnata or Dactylorhiza fuchsii. This plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been studied for their potential health benefits. The health benefits of Dactylorhiza × conigera nothosubsp. evae include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections.
